sources.entry: DisconfirmAI - AI investment research and reading tool that looks for evidence against your thesis before you commit, with daily source reading, filings and earnings research, condition-based change alerts and a personal investment framework. #freemium #research

summary.name: DisconfirmAI
summary.one_liner: DisconfirmAI is an AI investment research tool that gathers daily AI and investing reading, helps analyze filings, and tests your investment views against contrary evidence.
use_cases: Testing an investment thesis against contrary evidence
Reading daily AI and investing news with original sources
Analyzing a company's quarterly filings and revenue
Setting alerts for conditions tied to a watched company or theme
Writing and reviewing a personal investment framework
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a daily reading section that collects AI and investing items from public sources, each with its original link and date, and separates short cards from longer essays. Its research feature can read filings, pull data and run comparisons, with answers meant to separate verified, inferred and doubtful points. A Radar component is described as scanning companies, themes or conditions on a user-set schedule and reporting only material changes. Users can write their own investment framework, which research and reading are checked against. The page also lists public resources including an AI 100 company ranking, an AI industry map and 23 investment tools, and states it gives no buy or sell calls.
notable: Looks for evidence against your own investment thesis before you commit
Daily AI and investing reading with original source links and dates kept
Personal investment framework that research is checked against
Public reading and resources available without sign-in
caveats: Saving articles, following companies, personal research and long-term tracking require an account (one Google sign-in)
Generated answers and automated checks can be wrong; the page says to verify original sources and dates
Gives no stock recommendations, trade execution or return promises by design
